title: Coast Guard delivers FEMA aid to Hurricane Maria-impacted citizens in San Sebastian, Puerto Rico
description: Coast Guard Petty Officer 2nd Class Omar Alba, rescue swimmer, and Coast Guard Petty Officer 3rd Class Shevas Aboubakri, flight mechanic, deliver food and water from the Federal Emergency Management Agency to survivors of Hurricane Maria near San Sebastian, Puerto Rico, Oct. 13, 2017, from a Coast Guard Air Station Borinquen MH-65 Dolphin helicopter. Personnel operating out of Air Station Borinquen have been helping deliver relief supplies to remote areas stranded by mudslide and washed-out roads. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Omar Alba.
